simulation_prefix: docker exec -w /ros2_ws/src -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 -e OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 -e ROS_DOMAIN_ID=222 -e ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1 gng_cpu_container bash -c
native_build_install: docker exec -w /ros2_ws/src gng_cpu_container bash -c 'cmake -S gng_vlut_system -B /tmp/gng_vlut_pursuit_build -Denable_region_kernel_only=ON -Denable_vlut_kernel=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/ros2_ws/install/gng_vlut_system && cmake --build /tmp/gng_vlut_pursuit_build --target gng_dynamic_kernel -j2 && cmake --install /tmp/gng_vlut_pursuit_build --component dynamic_kernel'
numeric_compatibility_build: docker exec -w /ros2_ws/src gng_cpu_container bash -c 'timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=5 60 cmake -S gng_vlut_system -B /tmp/gng_numeric_compat_build -Denable_region_kernel_only=ON -Denable_vlut_kernel=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && exec timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=5 60 cmake --build /tmp/gng_numeric_compat_build --target gng_dynamic_kernel -j2'
regression_inner_command: timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=5 180 python3 -m unittest log.artifacts.avoidance_reliability.check_reliability log.artifacts.internal_clearance_fix.check_internal log.artifacts.coordinated_avoidance.check_coordinated log.artifacts.left_front_shuttle.check_candidates log.artifacts.cartesian_shuttle.check_task log.artifacts.pursuit_v2.check_pursuit log.artifacts.pursuit_fixes.check_fixes log.artifacts.pursuit_target.check_target log.artifacts.pursuit_smooth.check_qp log.artifacts.random_walk.check_walk log.artifacts.vlut_pursuit.check_vlut log.artifacts.vlut_pursuit.check_solver
final_metrics_regression_inner_command: timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=5 50 python3 -m unittest log.artifacts.pursuit_smooth.check_qp log.artifacts.vlut_pursuit.check_vlut log.artifacts.vlut_pursuit.check_solver

intentional_runtime_replacement.authority: 画面サーバー・点群ブリッジの今後の短時間再起動へのユーザー許可
